nesnd_supply_rules.zh:
#bold 货源#!
纸张、工具、小武器无本国短缺，价格涨幅不超过#v 50%#!；东洲另需硬木。

#bold 工场与人手#!
所需建筑各有至少一座雇员达到#v 75%#!，且不缺生产投入。湖广为大学与军营；四川为工具厂，以及铁矿或伐木场；广西为纸厂与伐木场；东洲为港口与官署。招工困难时可查看[concept_pop_qualifications]、[concept_building_wage]与原料供应。

#bold 生计#!
全国无业劳动力不超过#v 12%#!；劳动力至少#v 5万#!的州不超过#v 20%#!。自给农民属于有业人口。全国无饥荒，粮食无本国短缺且涨价不超过#v 25%#!。
现有无业劳动力：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#!（#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!）；超过地方失业界线的州：#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!。

#bold 商路安定#!
处于共同市场时，商贸安排自动满足；本国单独掌管市场时，可确定联络伙伴或由商人自行往来。四项条件连续维持#v 12周#!。战争、破产、市场改变或任一条件不满足，连续周数重新计算。
nesnd_supply_rules.en:
#bold Supplies#!
Paper, tools and small arms must have no local shortages and cost no more than #v 50%#! above base price; Dongzhou also requires hardwood.

#bold Buildings and workers#!
Each required building type must have at least one building staffed to #v 75%#! without input shortages. Huguang requires a university and barracks; Sichuan a tooling workshop and either an iron mine or logging camp; Guangxi a paper mill and logging camp; Dongzhou a port and government administration. If recruitment is difficult, check [concept_pop_qualifications], [concept_building_wage] and input supplies.

#bold Livelihoods#!
Unemployed workers may be at most #v 12%#! of the national workforce. States with at least #v 50,000#! workers have a limit of #v 20%#!. Subsistence workers count as employed. There must be no famine or local grain shortage, and grain must cost no more than #v 25%#! above base price.
Unemployed workforce: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployed').GetValue|0] / [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_workforce').GetValue|0]#! (#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!). States above the local unemployment limit: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_supply_critical_states').GetValue|0]#!.

#bold Stable commerce#!
A shared market automatically fulfils the commercial-arrangements requirement. A country alone in its market may choose a contact or leave dealings to its merchants. Maintain all four conditions for #v 12 weeks#!. War, bankruptcy, a change of market or failure of any condition restarts the consecutive count.
nesnd_supply_rules.reason: Explain the actual market read and retained independent-market policy choice. Prices, local shortages and domestic specialisations remain unchanged; no autarky requirement is added.
